answer_1.quote: We consider two tasks: question answering (QA) and value alignment (VA).
answer_1.outputs: The paper focuses on fine-tuning LLMs for question answering and value alignment, which involve natural language generation as part of the model outputs.

answer_2.quote: For QA performance, we report results on the ARC easy and challenge benchmark, taking the average of both sets as the ARC score; for the VA task, we evaluate using MT-bench and MMLU following.
